name: Wrists After Typing
description: Five very light moves to shake out and soften the wrists and forearms.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Five light moves for wrists and forearms, with counted and timed steps, on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do one move or all five.
howToPlay: Take your hands off the keyboard and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or count at your own pace.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Keep every move small and easy, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
